_comment: PINNED voice-engine model manifest — blueprint §47.1/§47.2. This file ships inside the APK (android/app/src/main/assets/voice/) and is the ONLY source TalosVoiceModelInstaller trusts for what to download and which hash to require: never a mutable remote JSON. Editing this file is a promotion event, not a routine change — see the promotion workflow note below before touching a revision or a hash.

promotion._comment: Blueprint §47.1 promotion workflow: candidate upstream SHA -> source diff review -> artifact hash inventory -> Android golden parity -> device benchmark -> speaker-quality regression -> release smoke -> promote exact SHA. Never 'revision: main'.
promotion.candidateSource: the exact commit already resident on the OnePlus Pad 3 reference device since Fase 0 (2026-08-21), used for every Fase 0-4 test and demo this session — Android golden parity, device benchmark, and speaker-quality regression are the accumulated Fase 0-4 record itself, not a separate step redone here.
promotion.hashInventoryVerifiedAgainst: live HuggingFace tree API (recursive), 2026-08-22 — cross-checked against the .cache/huggingface download metadata already present in the device's model directory (independent second source, same values), and against a fresh direct fetch+hash of browser_poc_manifest.json from the HF resolve endpoint (third independent source, same sha256).
promotion.releaseSmoke: PENDING — required before this manifest is used to drive a real install/update on a non-reference device.

license.redistributionConditions: Apache-2.0, both model repos public and non-gated — verified via the HuggingFace API at pin time.
license.builtInReferenceVoiceLicense: none — TALOS ships no third-party voice; builtin_voices in browser_poc_manifest.json are prompt codes for the base model's own voice, not a redistributed personal voice.
